heading.purpose: Page titles ('Instances', a game or instance name).

body.purpose: Default UI text: table cells, labels, descriptions.

label.purpose: Bounded data: table column headers and status badges (uppercase, 0.04em tracking).

mono.purpose: Raw logs, IDs, and code only; never to signal steady state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action per view (Start, Install / update, New instance).

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Reversible per-row actions (Restart, Stop, Manage). Compact 1.75rem height.

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Quiet destructive treatment: alarm text on a low-opacity alarm fill, never a solid red button.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.375rem;border-radius:0;font-size:0.875rem;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 0.15s ease;height:2rem;padding:0 0.625rem;border:1px solid transparent;background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive),transparent 90%);color:var(--destructive);} .ds-btn-destructive:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive),transparent 80%);} .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Default Badge
components.description: Neutral solid label, e.g. an instance that is running. Square, uppercase, never colored.

components.name: Outline Badge
components.description: Ruled label for metadata such as tags, execution mode, or install state.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered rectangle with a 1px rule and no shadow; used for summaries and detail groups, not repeated records.

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact rectangular text field (e.g. the Create instance dialog).

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Flat row; the active route has a 2px neutral left rule and a subtle field, and hover strengthens the same relationship.

components.name: Route Tabs
components.description: Line navigation used by the game and instance views: real links, foreground bottom rule on the active item, 44px hit area on touch.

components.name: Game Card
components.description: Games-list entry: banner thumbnail strip, name as the single stretched link, instance count, and install-state badge.

components.description: Game or instance header over the game banner: strongest at the top edge, fading to the page background by the first screenful. Art is atmosphere only and never carries state.

narrative.overview:
Odin is a self-hosted control panel for independent game servers. An administrator needs to scan live state, find the relevant server, and act without mistaking routine information for an alert. The dashboard therefore uses a rectilinear panel language: matte neutral surfaces, 1px rules, compact controls, and deliberate empty space. It is assertive through structure, not decoration.

The existing Odin mark (web/public/logo.png) remains the product signature. Its painterly cyan and amber language does not enter the interface system. The single sanctioned use of game imagery is the game atmosphere: a game's banner fading from the top of its game and instance pages into the plain page background, and a thumbnail on its games-list card.
keyCharacteristics: Near-achromatic neutral surfaces in both themes; Geist Variable is the sole typeface.
Every ordinary radius is 0px; depth is a 1px rule plus a surface change, never a shadow.
Color is reserved for Alarm, Signal OK, and Signal Warn; routine running/stopped stays neutral.
Tabs are always line navigation, implemented as real router links.
Game banner art appears only as top-down faded atmosphere on game/instance headers and as a games-list thumbnail.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Routine running and stopped states stay neutral. Color reports a meaningful operational fact, never a route, button, or decoration. Game banner art is atmosphere, not a signal, and never encodes state.

rules.name: The Game Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: A game's banner may appear only as a thumbnail on its games-list card and as a page backdrop behind the game and instance headers. It is anchored to the top of the page and fades into --background (a scrim built from that token, so it holds in both themes), reaching the plain page surface within the first screenful. Anything overlapping the lower backdrop (tabs, first panel, console) sits under a scrim of at least 88%, so reading and controls never depend on the art.

dos: Do use borders and whitespace to establish hierarchy.
Do keep route, status, focus, error, disabled, loading, and empty states legible in both themes.
Do preserve square geometry across shared and one-off components.
donts: Don't add shadows, soft cards, pill badges, or rounded control groups.
Don't use the logo's palette or neon effects, or use game imagery anywhere beyond the game atmosphere.
Don't use mono as a generic technical costume or color to signify steady state.
